notes.title: Developer's Diary 1. The characters of the game
notes.content:
Hi! 
You may have noticed that the Steam page has been updated and there are five beautiful girls on it, which will be discussed in this post.

Please add the game to you wishlist, it is very important for us

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900788/a6878a166c30c5f7408cec927fbb22c07f72e20e.png
 
The first heroine. Pale skin, tired appearance. Yes, this is a typical dead-inside girl with zxc and 1000-7 vibe. Surely that's what you imagine when you hear the word "Alt-girl". The first time you play the game, only she will be available, and after that you will be able to open other characters. Each girl will have her own mini-games, so Daria has a "Tattoo making" and a small platformer. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900788/fe4efb161a5f34a7c2eb7ba6ca29ed559a5a8ecc.png
 
Polina is a representative of such a subculture as "Wine-chan"! Apparently she came to us right from 2017 (one of the best years that I think it was). She is very smart, educated, even if she dropped out of philological university. He fumbles for literature and likes to demonstrate his knowledge of philosophy as well as wine.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900788/496a7762800c5e367322b2b1346e7a5e25f0b864.png

An extremely optimistic girl from whom youthful maximalism beats. The skate is her best friend, and the helmet is her main enemy. He is fond of unusual activities, loves tarot cards, even if he considers them utter nonsense and even tried programming. A single-minded girl with skeletons in her closet. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900788/a078335f0297bdde5aee1148821556f6a2ab8daf.png

She reminds me of someone, but I can't remember. She has a familiar sweater, likes to play rock, or rather grunge and alternative. She's the one who keeps you awake at night, because at two o'clock she turns on the electric guitar, turns on the distortion (wzhzh-wzhhzzz-wzhz sound) and starts playing until the neighbors come and tell her to calm down.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900788/aab161bf33451ea37fb8ec162e49628a0d0dbf8e.png

Uh... Does she have tails...? Cat ears or fox ears? Who is she? The result of Japanese experiments? The development of Elon Musk or who? The most we know is that this is an ALTERNATIVE TO PARALLEL IMPORT! She even knows Russian. I wonder what this wife cat is capable of?
